scripts.check: bun run check:repository && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run check:capability-leaks && bun run check:identifier-leaks
scripts.check:portable: bun run check:repository && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test:portable && bun run check:capability-leaks && bun run check:identifier-leaks
scripts.check:order: bun run check:order:pins && bun run check:repository && bun test scripts/upstream-pins.test.ts scripts/site-coherence.test.ts scripts/ledger-structure.test.ts
scripts.check:order:pins: bun --eval 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import Ajv2020 from "ajv/dist/2020.js"; import addFormats from "ajv-formats"; import { parseQualificationPins } from "./scripts/stable-qualification.ts"; import { applyUpstreamPins } from "./scripts/upstream-pins.ts"; const lock = await Bun.file("UPSTREAM.lock.json").json(); const windows = await Bun.file("scripts/windows-qualification-pins.json").json(); const ajv = new Ajv2020({ strict: true, allErrors: true }); addFormats(ajv); const validate = (schema, value, name) => { const check = ajv.compile(schema); assert(check(value), name + ": " + ajv.errorsText(check.errors)); }; validate(await Bun.file("schemas/upstream-lock.schema.json").json(), lock, "UPSTREAM.lock.json"); const version = { type: "string", pattern: "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)$" }; const hash = { type: "string", pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }; const commit = { type: "string", pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{40}$" }; const properties = Object.fromEntries([...["region", "plan", "osName", "tailscalePublisher"].map(key => [key, { type: "string", minLength: 1 }]), ...["bunVersion", "tailscaleVersion", "pywinrmVersion", "freerdpVersion"].map(key => [key, version]), ...["bunSha256", "tailscaleSha256"].map(key => [key, hash]), ...["osId", "cpus", "memoryMiB"].map(key => [key, { type: "integer", minimum: 1 }])]); const omp = { version, sourceCommit: commit, sourceTree: commit, nativeFile: { type: "string", pattern: "^pi_natives[.]win32-x64(?:-[A-Za-z0-9-]+)?[.]node$" }, nativeTarballSha256: hash, nativeBinarySha256: hash }; properties.omp = { type: "object", additionalProperties: false, required: Object.keys(omp), properties: omp }; validate({ type: "object", additionalProperties: false, required: Object.keys(properties), properties }, windows, "windows-qualification-pins.json"); const pins = parseQualificationPins(JSON.stringify(lock)); assert.equal(pins.bunVersion, Bun.version, "lock Bun must match the pinned order runtime"); const next = applyUpstreamPins(lock, windows, { version: pins.version, tag: "v" + pins.version, commit: pins.sourceCommit, tree: pins.sourceTree, collabWebVersion: lock.packageVersions["@oh-my-pi/collab-web"], darwinArm64Native: lock.darwinArm64Native, win32X64Native: { tarballSha256: windows.omp.nativeTarballSha256, binarySha256: windows.omp.nativeBinarySha256 } }, lock.observedAt); assert.deepEqual(next, { lock, windows }, "derived lock and Windows pin fields must agree"); console.log("offline order pins passed");'
